description: Edge case: value chosen so the derived fee does not divide cleanly across the four pools. value=333333333 × 0.01 → rawFee=3333333. burn/community/agent are floored independently; validator is the arithmetic remainder (feeAmount - burn - community - agent). Pins Fee Conservation: burn + validator + community + agent must exactly equal feeAmount regardless of rounding. A refactor that floors validator instead of computing it as the remainder would break this vector.
